doc.snippet: Defines MessageThread, UserMessage, AnnieMessage, MessageContent components in web/src/components/chat/. Zustand store with messages Record and streamingMessage. Dependencies include react-markdown, react-syntax-highlighter, @tanstack/react-virtual.

doc.snippet: P0 estimate 1.5 days. Files: MessageThread.tsx, UserMessage.tsx, AnnieMessage.tsx, MessageContent.tsx. Acceptance criteria include message thread with auto-scroll, markdown rendering, file attachments display, virtualized list for performance.

doc.title: Story 20.5: Chat Interface - Message Display
doc.section: Dev Notes - Markdown Configuration, Virtual Scrolling
doc.snippet: ReactMarkdown with remarkGfm for GFM support. SyntaxHighlighter with oneDark theme for code blocks. @tanstack/react-virtual useVirtualizer with estimateSize 100px and overscan 5. Smooth scroll via scrollIntoView.

doc.title: Annie Project Documentation
doc.snippet: FileAttachment model includes filename, mime_type, size_bytes, data_base64. Supports images (inline), documents (as cards). Backend processes files via Gemini native multimodal with ChatGPT fallback.

artifact.reason: Reference model for frontend FileAttachment component - defines filename, mime_type, size_bytes properties and is_image(), is_document() methods for rendering logic.
Defines SSE event types (status, token, tool_call, tool_result, done, error) that MessageThread must handle. format_status_frame shows event structure.
Defines API contract for chat endpoint including files field. ChatResponse shows conversation_id and stream_url for SSE connection.

frontend.package: Icons for copy button, file type indicators

constraints.constraint: Components must be created in web/src/components/chat/ directory following the project structure defined in tech context
Messages must be stored in Zustand store with Record<string, Message[]> structure keyed by conversation_id
Virtual scrolling required for 100+ messages using @tanstack/react-virtual with overscan of 5
Use Tailwind CSS with shadcn/ui patterns. User messages blue tint (bg-blue-100/bg-blue-900), Annie messages gray (bg-gray-100/bg-gray-800)
WCAG 2.1 AA compliance. Proper ARIA labels, keyboard navigation support, reduced motion support
Links must open in new tab with rel="noopener noreferrer" to prevent tabnabbing
Support dark mode via system preference (prefers-color-scheme)
This story depends on Story 20.1 (Project Setup) completing first to create web/ directory and install packages

interface.name: Message
interface.signature: interface Message { id: string; role: 'user' | 'assistant'; content: string; timestamp: string; files?: FileAttachment[]; }

interface.name: FileAttachment (Frontend)
interface.signature: interface FileAttachment { filename: string; mime_type: string; size_bytes: number; url?: string; }

interface.name: SSE Event
interface.signature: { type: "status" | "token" | "tool_call" | "tool_result" | "done" | "error", message?: string, content?: string, name?: string, args?: object, code?: string }

interface.name: Zustand Store Actions
interface.signature: addMessage(conversationId: string, message: Message): void; setStreamingMessage(content: string | null): void;

tests.standards: Unit tests with Jest + React Testing Library for component testing. Test message rendering, markdown parsing, accessibility. Mock Zustand store for isolated component tests. Use testing-library/user-event for interaction testing (hover, click). Snapshot tests for complex markdown rendering. Accessibility tests with jest-axe for WCAG compliance.
